title: OpenMHS capability class definition
description: Defines one capability class as published in the MHS capability registry (MHS/spec/capabilities.json, normative). The class id carries the MAJOR version (v<major>). Entries are FLAT by design: summary, tags, units, effects, hazards, preconditions, postconditions, determinism, concurrency and risk_class live on the entry. A nested `semantics` object is NOT part of the contract (SPEC-002).

status.description: Lifecycle: stable (supported), experimental (schema may change; binding requires x-mhs-experimental), deprecated (still valid and callable; migrate per x-mhs-replaced-by). 'active' is the pre-0.9 spelling of stable and is accepted for older class documents.

profile.description: core: usable on any device mode; sim: Sim/Fidelity profile class (world.*), only for simulated, hybrid or replay devices.

since.description: OpenMHS specification release (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of the catalogue's spec_version, e.g. 0.9.0) that introduced the class in its current form; never later than spec_version. Independent of the class MAJOR (v<major>) and of the wire revision (mhs_capabilities).

verb.description: read never changes device state or the revision; write sets named parameters; invoke performs an action. subscribe and compose are reserved.

domain.description: Capability domain code, e.g. world, motion, fluid, measure, device.

resource_kinds.description: Resource kinds this class can bind to, e.g. robot.arm, lab.liquid_handler, world.sim. '*' (used only by cap.device.configure.v1) means any resource kind the device declares.

modes.description: Device modes in which this class may be bound (world.* classes are simulated/hybrid/replay only).

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the capability input. Numeric physical fields MUST carry x-mhs-unit; a temperature difference (a tolerance, a rate such as K/min) also carries x-mhs-delta: true, so unit conversion never applies the Kelvin/Celsius offset to it.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the capability output (x-mhs-unit and x-mhs-delta as for input_schema).

examples.description: Example inputs; each MUST validate against input_schema (the catalogue carries at least one per class).

summary.description: Model-readable description of what the action does in the physical or simulated world.

units.description: Map of field name to UCUM unit for fields whose unit is not already carried by x-mhs-unit.

effects.description: Effect taxonomy, e.g. motion.joint, material.transfer, energy.emission, measurement.capture.

long_running.description: The deadline bounds only the response; the operation continues and reports through operation_id.

limits.description: Unused legacy location; prefer the top-level limits member.

x-mhs-replaced-by.description: For a deprecated class: the protocol method or class that replaces it (CAP-040).

limits.description: Class limits keyed by limit path: {path: {min,max,allowed,unit,reason,...}}. Bindings, device envelopes and operator overlays may narrow but never widen them; input_schema bounds never exceed them.

requires_permit.description: True when invoking this class needs a permit/approval (R2/R3 or process-gated).
